SummarizedExperiment7

An S7 implementation of the SummarizedExperiment and RangedSummarizedExperiment data structures, built from the language-agnostic biocspec specification rather than from Bioconductor’s S4 source. It is conformant with that specification without necessarily replicating every implementation detail of the S4 original — notably, there is no automatic class promotion/demotion on rowRanges7<-; use toRangedSummarizedExperiment7() and toSummarizedExperiment7() instead.

Installation 

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("vjcitn/SummarizedExperiment7")

Usage 

library(SummarizedExperiment7)

m <- matrix(1:6, nrow = 2, ncol = 3,
            dimnames = list(c("g1", "g2"), c("s1", "s2", "s3")))

se <- SummarizedExperiment7(
  assays = list(counts = m),
  colData = data.frame(group = c("a", "a", "b"), row.names = c("s1", "s2", "s3"))
)

se
dim(se)
assay7(se, "counts")
colData7(se)

Testing 

devtools::test()
